structuralFindings: KES rate card prices per ROOM TYPE by occupancy (Single/Double/Triple), across three meal plans (Half Board, Full Board, All Inclusive) and four date bands — not a per-person figure directly comparable to the USD operator sheet without dividing by occupancy.

USD Operator sheet is genuinely per-person-per-day, with explicit Single / Half-Dbl(p.p.) / 3rd-pax columns, across 5 numbered seasons and 3 meal plans (BB/HB/AI) for one room category (Standard Room). This is the cleaner one for per-person quoting.

The two sheets' season windows do NOT line up 1:1: KES sheet uses 4 bands (23 Dec-4 Jan, 5 Jan-2 Apr, 3 Apr-5 Apr, 6 Apr-22 Dec), USD sheet uses 5 bands (01-05 Jan, 06 Jan-30 Apr, 01 May-30 Jun, 01 Jul-21 Dec, 22-31 Dec) — don't assume they're the same calendar shape; each currency's own season table must be used for its own currency.

Base meal plan for the USD Operator sheet appears to be BB (Bed & Breakfast) with HB/AI as line items in the same table, each independently priced — not a base-plus-supplement structure. The KES sheet is similarly three independently-priced meal-plan rows, not base+supplement, though a Full Board supplement of $10pp/night off HB is separately stated on the USD sheet as an alternate route to Full Board.

Ocean view / Outdoor living room / Junior Suite are per-night supplements on top of the Standard Room base rate, in both currencies, with different amounts between the two sheets (e.g. Ocean view: KES 2,000/night vs USD $16/night — these are not simple currency conversions of each other, check separately).
